benefits.name: Anniversary Free Night Award
benefits.description: One free night award each account anniversary year, redeemable at IHG hotels costing up to 40,000 points per night (points can be added to redeem at higher-value properties).
benefits.terms: Cap is scheduled to increase to 50,000 points per night starting in 2027 per current IHG announcements; confirm this is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Platinum Elite status for as long as the account is open, including a higher IHG stay earning multiplier.
benefits.terms: Status is applied to the linked IHG One Rewards account roughly 6-8 weeks after account opening.

benefits.name: $100 Statement Credit + 10,000 Bonus Points
benefits.description: $100 statement credit and 10,000 bonus IHG points each calendar year after $20,000 in card spend.
benefits.terms: Requires $20,000 in calendar-year card spend. Also awards 10,000 bonus IHG One Rewards points.

benefits.name: TSA PreCheck / Global Entry Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a TSA PreCheck or Global Entry application fee.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership
benefits.description: One year of complimentary DashPass membership, plus quarterly DoorDash discounts on non-restaurant orders.

benefits.name: Complimentary Instacart+ Membership
benefits.description: 3 months of complimentary Instacart+ membership plus monthly $10 Instacart credits.
benefits.terms: Requires activation; promotional and time-limited per current terms, confirm still current before relying on it.

earningRates.terms: Also includes general business purchases (e.g. office supply stores, internet/cable/phone services).
